U.note: Top-down 32x32 with real column stacking (height cap 6), remove mode, undo, keyboard shortcuts, but only three block types, an empty start, and the mobile toolbar overflows.

V.note: Side-view 32x32 world with a textured starter landscape, ten block types, drag painting with interpolation, undo, reset, autosave and a tidy mobile layout.

W.note: Plain flat-color DOM grid on a dark empty board with 8 types, undo and autosave; functional but bare and the board reads as dark and lifeless.

X.note: Isometric 32x32 voxel world with stackable blocks, shaded faces, translucent water and glass, starter terrain, place/erase modes, picking and undo; the strongest block-building feel, though redraws are heavy and the mobile view is small.

Y.note: Flat top-down painter with 8 types, undo, PNG save and autosave; the grid lines render unevenly on mobile and there is no height.

Z.note: Polished and accessible flat grid with counts, status messages, a two-step clear and focus states, but only four block types, an empty start, and the status and help text fall below the fold on desktop.
